owner.name: Spencer Brake
owner.tagline: Builder of practical apps for real, often overlooked places.
owner.blurb: I build useful systems for places where the usual assumptions do not hold.
owner.about: I am a builder and systems architect focused on the operational layer: how people move, pay, queue, book, dispatch, discover work, and keep track of what matters. I live and work in the remote North of Canada, where I work in retail management and build around the constraints I see firsthand—spotty connectivity, no card payments, civic-number addresses, field work, and people who should not need a manual. I am also a sound engineer and a certified minerals prospector, happiest panning for gold or looking at rocks. Through Presidia Corp, the problem-solving corporation, I turn real constraints into simple, durable tools that fit the place they are meant to serve.

projects.name: KnowYourLocal
projects.description: A PWA connecting people with local tradespeople and services, with Stripe Connect escrow so money is only released when the work is done. Availability is baked into each paid ad and a filterable work-photo feed drives discovery.

projects.name: Chewdash Taxi
projects.tagline: Ride-booking for a remote Nunavik town
projects.description: An offline-first ride-booking PWA for a taxi business in Kuujjuarapik. Built to be dead simple — a teen or an elder can book with no instruction — and to work with no card payments and spotty connectivity. Live and monetized.

projects.name: Ponte
projects.description: A video-call app with real-time captions that translate between languages on every call, powered by Claude. Static frontend on Vercel, Express API on Railway. Live and in daily use since May 2026.

projects.name: Weedback
projects.description: A web app for grading cannabis — scoring and rating quality — built on Next.js and deployed to production.

projects.name: Northern Utility Dispatch
projects.tagline: Oil, water & sewage dispatch for the North
projects.description: A request → dispatch → driver workflow for utility deliveries in northern Quebec and Nunavut, built around civic-number houses and no card payments. A live demo aimed at regional government buyers.

projects.name: Q
projects.description: A fast-admission and queueing system for bars, clubs, and other time-sensitive venues. Uses geolocation and geo-fencing to build real-time queues — a restaurant buzzer for your night out — while giving venues live occupancy data.

projects.name: SpennyBurger
projects.description: A DoorDash-style ordering portal for a single-product pop-up burger business: one burger, real Stripe payments, and a kitchen view that texts customers when their order is ready. Ran live; archived for future use.

projects.name: eProspector
projects.description: A field-notebook-inspired exploration workspace for prospectors to log, map, and track mineral deposits, with an interactive map and cloud-synced notes.

projects.name: Invstar
projects.description: A retail and quick-service-restaurant tool for managing inventory and orders — keeping stock counts and order flow in one place for fast-moving front counters.

projects.name: MetalPRO Terminal
projects.description: A browser terminal for tracking precious metals, mining equities, energy commodities, rare earth elements, and strategic minerals — built for critical-mineral and conflict-resource trading analysis. Live prices via Yahoo Finance, OHLC candlestick charts, futures curves, and keyboard-driven views (MRKT, PREC, MINE, NRGY, REES, and more).

projects.name: COMMAND NODE
projects.tagline: Real-time global warfare, Cold War console
projects.description: A real-time, Risk-style browser game of global conquest wrapped in a Cold War command-console aesthetic — glowing terminals, live fronts, and persistent world state.
